title: To Generate or Discriminate? Methodological Considerations for Measuring Cultural Alignment in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cultural alignment and stereotyping using Inverse Socio-Demographic Prompting (ISDP). The models are tasked with predicting a user's demographic proxy (country of origin: India, Mexico, or the USA) based on actual versus model-simulated behavior regarding which Culture-Specific Items (CSIs) in English book reviews the user finds difficult to understand.
